items.name: covenant-compliance
items.title: Covenant compliance
items.description: Displays a native covenant series as a covenant by test-date grid of returned verdicts; selecting a date shows its covenant reports.
items.docs: Present native DatedCovenantReports rows (statements_analytics.evaluateCovenants over statement results, or CovenantEngine#evaluateSeries over dated rows) as a grid: one column per test date in the order supplied, one row per covenant instance key in first-appearance order, each cell the returned verdict as Passed or Failed, or a dash when Rust returned no report for that covenant on that date. A date header button selects the date (the latest initially) and its reports render below through covenant-report. Nothing is computed, sorted or inferred. No worker is required.

items.name: covenant-report
items.title: Covenant report
items.description: Displays native covenant reports: test, actual, threshold, headroom, verdict and details per covenant, with the complete JSON.
items.docs: Present native CovenantReport values keyed by covenant instance key (CovenantEngine#evaluate, one DatedCovenantReports row, or a valuation result's covenants) as a typed table in the order supplied: Rust's test description, actual value, threshold and headroom with every supplied digit (a host may inject formatValue), the passed verdict as Passed or Failed, and details; a field Rust leaves unset shows as a dash. The complete reports stay available as JSON in a Covenants disclosure. No verdict, headroom or threshold is computed. No worker is required.
